description: Observed-peptide coverage of RPL36A and RPL36AL in public MS repositories, testing whether the discriminating residue 38 is already covered
code:
import requests, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"Accept":"application/json"}
store={}
for acc,sym in [("P83881","RPL36A"),("Q969Q0","RPL36AL")]:
    j=requests.get(f"https://www.ebi.ac.uk/proteins/api/proteomics/{acc}",headers=H,timeout=120).json()
    feats=(j[0] if isinstance(j,list) else j)["features"]
    rows=[]
    for f in feats:
        evs=f.get("evidences",[])
        srcs=sorted({e["source"]["name"] for e in evs if isinstance(e.get("source"),dict) and "name" in e["source"]})
        nobs=[]
        for e in evs:
            p=(e.get("source") or {}).get("properties") or {}
            if "Times of observations" in p: nobs.append(int(p["Times of observations"]))
            if "Number of PSMs" in p: nobs.append(int(p["Number of PSMs"]))
        rows.append(dict(begin=int(f["begin"]),end=int(f["end"]),peptide=f.get("peptide",""),
                         length=len(f.get("peptide","")),unique=f.get("unique"),
                         sources=";".join(srcs),max_obs=max(nobs) if nobs else None))
    d=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(["begin","end"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    store[sym]=d
    cov=np.zeros(107,bool)
    for _,r in d.iterrows(): cov[r.begin:r.end+1]=True
    span=d[(d.begin<=38)&(d.end>=38)]
    print(f"\n===== {sym} ({acc}) =====")
    print(f"observed peptides: {len(d)}   coverage: {cov[1:].sum()}/106 ({100*cov[1:].sum()/106:.0f}%)")
    print(f"peptides spanning residue 38: {len(span)}")
    print(span.to_string(index=False) if len(span) else "   (none)")
    print(d.to_string(index=False))
    d.to_csv(f"observed_peptides_{sym}.csv",index=False)

# coverage figure
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,3.2))
for i,(sym,col) in enumerate([("RPL36A","#2b6cb0"),("RPL36AL","#d69e2e")]):
    d=store[sym]
    for _,r in d.iterrows():
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((r.begin,i-0.3),r.end-r.begin+1,0.6,color=col,alpha=0.55))
    ax.text(-2,i,sym,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=10)
ax.axvline(38,color="#c53030",lw=2)
ax.text(38,1.75,"residue 38\n(K in RPL36A, R in RPL36AL)",color="#c53030",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(-18,110); ax.set_ylim(-0.8,2.1); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("residue position"); ax.set_title("Peptides already observed in public MS data (PeptideAtlas / ProteomicsDB via EBI Proteins API)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
